Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a night club singer and a 12-year old boy.

The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart.

But when the murderer strikes several more times with the same pattern, the detectives realize that they are chasing the country's first documented serial killer. Relying on only their basic skills and tools, Park and Cho attempt to piece together the clues and solve the case in this thriller based on true events.

The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core.

When he loses his heart to the gorgeous Hillary Flammond (Lucy Gutteridge), he finds himself caught up in an underground resistance movement. Rivers joins forces with Agent Cedric (Omar Sharif) and Flammond to attempt the rescue of her father, Dr. Paul (Michael Gough), from the Germans, who have captured the scientist in hopes of coercing him into building a new naval mine.

programme.desc: Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime boss Ida "Red" Walker turns to her son, Wyatt, to pull off one last heist to get out of prison. However, with the FBI closing in, Wyatt must soon choose between family and freedom.

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: Abandon
programme.desc: A psychological thriller about a senior (Katie Holmes) at one of America's most prestigious universities. Under enormous pressure to complete her thesis and earn a top job at one of the world's most competitive consulting firms, Katie is still coping with the sudden unexplained disappearance of her first love two years prior. As the investigation continues, Katie is forced to choose between past passions and new possibilities, even as new facts are uncovered.

programme.title: The Evening Star
programme.desc: A spunky woman (Shirley MacLaine) copes with her troubled adult grandchildren, feuds with an enemy and has a fling with a younger man (Bill Paxton).

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: Socially awkward Muriel Heslop (Toni Collette) wants nothing more than to get married. Unfortunately, due to her oppressive politician father (Bill Hunter), Muriel has never even been on a date. Ostracized by her more socially adept friends, Muriel runs into fellow outcast Rhonda Epinstalk (Rachel Griffiths), and the two move from their small Australian town to the big city of Sydney, where Muriel changes her name and begins the arduous task of redesigning her life to match her fantasies.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: Kate McKay (Meg Ryan) is a modern day executive, a 21st century woman driven to succeed in the corporate world. Leopold, the third Duke of Albany, is a charming gent and bachelor of the late 18OOs. With career and social expectations looming, each has grown cynical about the very notion of falling in love. But when a rip in the fabric of time thrusts Leopold into present day New York, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites.

programme.title: The Peacemaker

programme.title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: Repentinamente, Alice se encontró a sí misma en medio de un bosque que nunca había visto, y siendo observada por una criatura con cierto parecido a un hada. Entonces, una bruja montada en una escoba vino y las atacó; ella y el hada salieron huyendo sin saber por qué. Hasta esa mañana, Alice era una chica normal que se encontraba en clase sin atender demasiado a su profesora. Ella debiera haber sido tan sólo una niña de 11 años, que abría un libro titulado "Un libro que te hace bruja", el cual le había regalado su padre, y haberse imaginado a sí misma como una bruja. Ámbas fueron capturadas por la bruja y confinadas en una prisión para hadas. Pronto, unas brujas aprendizas, Sheila y Eva, llegaron y se quedaron sorprendidas de ver que había un humano en el mundo mágico. Alice también llegó a la conclusión de que aquello era un mundo mágico. ★ 6.5/10

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Robin Hood (Jonas Armstrong) es la historia de un muchacho que, tras cinco años luchando en las Cruzadas, vuelve a su Inglaterra natal donde tendrá que luchar de nuevo, esta vez por acabar con el abuso de autoridad del nuevo Sheriff de Nottingham. Para conseguirlo, cuenta con astutas tretas y un increíble manejo de arcos y espadas. Aclamada miniseri de la BBC sobre el clásico héroe de acción de los bosques de Sherwood, adaptada a un personaje algo más joven de lo habitual hasta la fecha, pero que mantiene el eterno romance entre Marian y Robin, así como las luchas con espadas y arcos y la lucha contra la injusticia, el hambre de un pueblo sometido a las leyes de un injusto Sheriff y de su aliado, Sir Guy de Gisborne. ★ 6.9/10

programme.title: Sí, quiero
programme.desc: ¡Sí, quiero ese vestido! descubre el funcionamiento interno de uno de los salones de vestidos de novia más importantes, Kleinfeld Bridal. Parte desfile de moda, parte historia nupcial, parte terapia familiar, este programa desvela los obstáculos a los que cada dependiente se enfrenta para satisfacer a cada novia en el que será el día más importante de su vida. Sumérgete en la travesía a través de la que un equipo de especialistas guía a las novias en el proceso de selección. ★ 7.1/10

programme.title: Royal Pains
programme.desc:
Royal Pains: es serie de televisión estadounidense de la cadena USA Network, la cual fue creada por Andrew Lenchewski y John P. Rogers. Protagonizada por Mark Feuerstein, se estrenó el 04 de junio de 2009.
En la serie Hank (Mark Feuerstein) es un médico cirujano de urgencias en Nueva York que se ve obligado a dejar la ciudad, después de haber sido injustamente acusado de la muerte de un paciente, para trabajar como médico a domicilio en un lugar muy exclusivo, ubicado en las afueras de la ciudad. La vida de Hank, un triunfador nato, se desbarató tras la negligencia médica. Pero siguiendo los consejos de su hermano Evan termina en Los Hampton, paraje escogido por los millonarios para pasar sus vacaciones de verano, un sitio que a Hank, al principio, le resulta totalmente ajeno.
Todo inicia cuando Evan le lleva a pasar un fin de semana a la exclusiva zona de los Hamptons y una casualidad provoca que Hank salve la vida a un hombre, con lo cual pronto toda la rica comunidad reclamará sus servicios como médico personal.
Hank en su nueva vida tendrá como acompañantes a su hermano, quien ve tener una oportunidad de oro para entrar en la vida de mujeres y dinero con la que siempre ha soñado; Divya Katdare, una joven de la alta sociedad cansada de su estilo de vida se apuntará como asistente de Hank; y Jill Casey, la administradora del hospital local de los Hamptons, quien pondrá a Hank en el compromiso de atender también a los menos favorecidos de la comunidad... ★ 6.7/10

programme.title: Law and Order
programme.desc: Serie sobre la investigación de crímenes en la ciudad de Nueva York. Policías y jueces son los principales protagonistas. ★ 7.3/10

programme.title: Falsa identidad
programme.desc: La historia de Isabel y Diego, dos extraños que deben huir de su pasado para escapar de sus enemigos. Diego dejó a su familia después de que su padre murió y su madre se volvió a casar. En un acto de rebelión, Diego se involucró en el mundo del crimen, vendiendo combustible al traficante de drogas más poderoso de la ciudad, Gavino Gaona. Isabel se casó con Porfirio “El Corona”, miembro de una banda norteña, cuando tenía 15 años y enfrenta una vida de abuso doméstico.Estos dos extraños que huyen de su pasado deben asumir nuevas identidades para hacerse pasar por una pareja felizmente casada y así escapar de sus enemigos y sobrevivir. ★ 7.6/10

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: Mi familia perfecta
programme.desc: La historia cuenta la historia de Los Guerrero, cinco hermanos que luchan por alcanzar el sueño americano y salir adelante después de la muerte de su padre y la deportación de su madre a México. Los Guerrero debe demostrar que son una familia muy unida para enfrentar los diferentes obstáculos y situaciones que enfrentan los inmigrantes en los Estados Unidos. Disfuncionales pero siempre unidos, estos hermanos, El Patas, Rosa, Marisol, Julián y Lili, vivirán la difícil situación de ver a su madre, Irma, tomar la dolorosa decisión de dejarlos en Houston, Estados Unidos para asegurarles un futuro mejor cuando sea deportada a México. A partir de este momento, los Guerrero deberán apoyarse mutuamente para superar los obstáculos de una familia inmigrante en los Estados Unidos, lograr el sueño americano y, al mismo tiempo, permanecer unidos bajo un mismo techo. ★ 3.2/10

programme.title: Esta semana
programme.desc: My Wife’s Having an Affair this Week: ¿A quién recurres cuando tu vida feliz se hace añicos? Do Hyun Woo (Lee Sun Gyun) es un productor de televisión que se considera bendecido por su carrera exitosa y un matrimonio feliz. Pero su feliz existencia se ve estremecida cuando ve por accidente un mensaje de texto enviado a su esposa, Jung Soo Yeon (Song Ji Hyo), de parte de un hombre misterioso llamado Michael quien le dice que ha reservado una habitación de hotel dentro de un par de días y que no puede esperar a verla. Convencido de que su esposa está teniendo una aventura, Hyun Woo no sabe a quién recurrir por ayuda para salvar su matrimonio, por lo que termina entrando en un foro en línea para pedir consejo anónimo por parte de extraños. Las personas más cercanas a Hyun Woo no le resultan de ninguna ayuda. Su colega Ahn Joon Young (Lee Sang Yeob) está casado, pero a la vez obsesionado con su compañera de trabajo Kwon Bo Young (BoA), quien está divorciada. Su amigo abogado, es un gran mujeriego que hace lo imposible para ocultarle sus infidelidades a su desconfiada esposa, Eun Ah Ra (Ye Ji Won). ¿Podrá Hyun Woo sobrevivir a la peor crisis de su vida? ★ 6.7/10

programme.title: El Chavo
programme.desc: "El Chavo del Ocho" es una serie mexicana que narra las historias de un niño mexicano de 8 años (El Chavo) que vive en una vecindad de la Ciudad de México, y con frecuencia se encuentra dentro de un barril situado en el patio de la vecindad. El programa explora, de manera cómica, los problemas que muchos niños de la calle experimentan a diario como el hambre, la tristeza y el no tener a alguien que cuide de ellos. El argumento pasaba por una serie de enredos y confusiones en que participan los personajes que creó el escritor Roberto Gómez Bolaños, Chespirito. ★ 8.0/10

programme.title: Tattletales
programme.desc: Tattletales is an American game show which first aired on the CBS daytime schedule on February 18, 1974. programme.desc: George Washington & Religious Freedom George Washington's Mount Vernon examines religion in early America and George Washington's role in ensuring religious freedom.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: Revolutionary Era & Founding of American Republic Scholars of American history, law, and politics explored the impact of the Revolutionary Era on the founding and development of the American republic. The event was hosted by the American Enterprise Institute in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: Revolutionary Era's Impact on the U.S. Constitution Scholars of American history, law, and politics explored the impact of the Revolutionary Era on the creation of the U.S. Constitution, ratified in 1787. The event was hosted by the American Enterprise Institute in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: Historian Drew Gilpin Faust on President James Buchanan Historian and former Harvard University president Drew Gilpin Faust reflects on the life and legacy of President James Buchanan. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday this year.

programme.title: The Civil War
programme.desc: Aeronaut Thaddeus Lowe Historian Cheryl McAuley discusses Thaddeus Lowe, a Civil War aeronaut, scientist, and inventor who became known as the founder of military aerial reconnaissance.

programme.title: America 250
programme.desc: Women's Wardrobes During the Revolutionary Era Historians discuss the textile choices of women in Revolutionary-era New England and how wardrobe preferences affected the Revolution.

programme.desc: Organization of American Historians President Annette Gordon-Reed and Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch address political controversies over how to present American history in museums, historic sites, and public displays.

programme.title: C-SPAN Tours the Muhammad Ali Center

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E18 — Times Circle; Super Gramma Tilly and Remy put on a play; Cricket meets his favorite heroes; when Gramma temporarily loses her eyesight, Cricket and Tilly try to help her.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E19 — Present Tense; Hurt Bike Cricket struggles to get the best birthday present for his best bud, Remy; due to a close call with a dirt bike, Cricket fearfully decides to live his life in shelter.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E20 — Quiet Please; Chipwrecked At the library, the Greens try to find a book, but a scary librarian threatens them into being quiet; Chip decides if he is really the failure Cricket says he is.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E21 — Chipocalypse Now Part 1; Chipocalypse Now Part 2 Chip Whistler tears down the buildings around the Green's house to build a Wholesome Foods store.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E22 — 'Rent Control; Pool's Gold When Gloria's parents visit, she ropes the Greens into escalating lies about her success; Cricket goes on a quest to find the best pool in Big City.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E23 — Big Resolution; Winter Greens On New Year's Eve, Cricket insists on helping Gloria complete her resolution of approaching her crush, Kevin; Cricket and Remy challenge Vasquez to a snowball fight; Tilly creates a snowperson.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E24 — Mages and Mazes; Okay Karaoke When the kids play a role-playing game at Remy's, his rules lead to conflict; when the Greens go out for karaoke, Tilly struggles to decide what genre of music will best express her true self.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E25 — Date Night; The Room Bill chaperones Cricket and Gabriella's first date; a disagreement between Cricket and Tilly turns into reality-TV-like entertainment for Gloria and Gramma.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E26 — Bleeped; Sellouts Cricket teaches the local kids a new curse word, threatening to ruin the community center's choir performance; the Greens try new methods to improve sales at their produce stand.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E27 — Fast Foodie; Spaghetti Theory Cricket tries to prove to Bill he can eat fast food for every meal; Tilly and Cricket debate whether the lives of people in Big City are connected.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E28 — Ding Dongers; Animation Abomination Remy uses Cricket's antics to gain views and likes on a new video-sharing app; Gloria gives Tilly and Cricket a tour of the animation studio where she's interning.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E29 — The Van; Bat Girl Gramma and Cricket fume over an unsightly van parked in front of their house; Nancy joins Cricket and Tilly's Little League team to get back at their unsportsmanlike rivals.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S02 E30 — Cousin Jilly; Gloria's Cafe Tilly revives Cousin Jilly, an alter-ego she created to entertain Cricket when they were younger; Gloria opens a secret café in the former Big Coffee space without permission.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Space Chicken; Steak Night To impress his new neighbors, Cricket attempts to launch a chicken into space; the Greens are excited to continue their traditional monthly steak dinner, but Cricket accidentally loses the steaks on the subway.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Cricket Versus; Blue Tater Cricket must wrestle a wild animal in order to prove himself worthy of the family name; when Cricket persuades Bill to convert his pickup into a french fry food truck, he discovers a mysterious blue potato that Gramma says is cursed with bad luck.

programme.title: Big City Greens
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Swimming Fool; Tilly's Goat When the Greens visit an indoor pool, Cricket is challenged to jump off the high dive; Tilly claims that the family's goat has the spirit of a dog and enters it in a dog show.

programme.title: The Last Dance Episode 1
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Episode 1 In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls begin their quest to win a sixth NBA title in eight years. But "The Last Dance," as coach Phil Jackson called it, will be shadowed by tension with the club's front office.

programme.title: The Last Dance Episode 2
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Episode 2 Michael Jordan is left to begin the 1997-98 season without his injured sidekick Scottie Pippen, whose contract dispute with the Bulls' front office reaches a fever pitch as the team gets off to one of the worst starts of its championship runs.

programme.title: The Last Dance Episode 3
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Episode 3 Once a key member of the hated Detroit Pistons' "Bad Boys" championship teams that brutalized Michael Jordan, Dennis Rodman is virtually all Jordan can count on in the early months of the 1997-98 season.

programme.title: The Last Dance Episode 4
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Episode 4 In what management insists is Phil Jackson's final season in Chicago as head coach of the Bulls, he continues to seem like the only one who can steer this unique, singular collection of talent to another title.

programme.desc: Kansas vs. Duke Storied programs in the No. 5 Blue Devils and No. 24 Jayhawks meet in the Champions Classic. Duke freshman forward Cameron Boozer, son of former Blue Devils star Carlos, averages 22.5 points per game after dropping 35 in his last outing.

programme.title: College Basketball Florida at Duke
programme.desc: Florida at Duke The Blue Devils (8-0) host the defending champion Gators (5-2) in an elite SEC/ACC Challenge match. Duke is 2-0 against the SEC this season, boasting wins over Texas and Arkansas on neutral courts. Florida has won six straight against ACC foes.

programme.title: College Basketball Georgia Tech at Duke
programme.desc: Georgia Tech at Duke No. 6 Duke hosts Georgia Tech at Cameron Indoor Stadium as ACC play heats up. Star Cameron Boozer leads the Blue Devils' offense while Kowacie Reeves Jr. anchors the Yellow Jackets. Duke aims to hold its rank in this marquee conference clash.

programme.title: College Basketball Duke at Louisville
programme.desc: Duke at Louisville No. 6 Duke faces No. 16 Louisville at the KFC Yum! Center. The Blue Devils rely on Cooper Boozer's 23.5 points per game. The Cardinals enter at 11-2 following a win over Cal, led by Ryan Conwell. Both teams clash to remain unbeaten in ACC play.

programme.title: College Basketball SMU at Duke
programme.desc: SMU at Duke The No. 24 SMU Mustangs visit the No. 6 Duke Blue Devils at Cameron Indoor Stadium. The freshman phenom Cameron Boozer leads Duke in scoring 23.3 PPG and rebounding 9.7 RPG. The engine of the Mustangs, Boopie Miller, scores 20.6 PPG and 7.1 APG.

programme.title: College Basketball Duke at Stanford
programme.desc: Duke at Stanford Stanford hosts No. 6 Duke for an ACC game at Maples Pavilion. Duke is 4-0 on the road, led by Cameron Boozer's 22.9 PPG. The Cardinal looks to Ebuka Okorie, who averages 22.1 PPG. The Blue Devils' offense faces a tough road test in California.

programme.title: College Basketball Louisville at Duke
programme.desc: Louisville at Duke From Cameron Indoor Stadium in Durham, N.C.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Basketball Duke at North Carolina
programme.desc: Duke at North Carolina No. 4 Duke (21-1) visits No. 14 North Carolina (18-4) in the Tobacco Road rivalry. UNC beat Syracuse 87-77 and Duke beat Boston College 67-49. The Blue Devils rely on freshman Cameron Boozer, who leads the nation with 23.5 points per game.

programme.title: College Basketball Duke at Pittsburgh
programme.desc: Duke at Pittsburgh Pittsburgh hosts No. 4 Duke at Petersen Events Center. The Blue Devils lead the series 18-7 since 2002 and won Jan. 24. The game features a mentor-student clash between Pitt's Jeff Capel and his former Duke pupil, Jon Scheyer, in an ACC showdown.

programme.title: College Basketball Clemson at Duke
programme.desc: Clemson at Duke The No. 4 Duke Blue Devils host No. 20 Clemson Tigers in a battle between the ACC's top two teams. The Blue Devils aim to maintain their unbeaten home record as Caleb Foster leads the charge against a high-scoring Tigers squad in Durham.

programme.title: College Basketball Syracuse at Duke
programme.desc: Syracuse at Duke Adrian Autry and the Orange face No. 4 Duke at Cameron Indoor Stadium for an ACC matchup Feb. 16. The Blue Devils have won 10 straight against Syracuse since 2019. In their last meeting Feb. 5, 2025, Duke secured a dominant 83-54 road victory.

programme.title: College Basketball Michigan vs. Duke
programme.desc: Michigan vs. Duke The No. 1 Wolverines face the No. 3 Blue Devils on a neutral floor for the seventh time in series history. Michigan seeks its first win over Duke since 2011, while Jon Scheyer's squad aims to bolster its case for a No. 1 seed in the NCAA tournament.

programme.desc: John T. Edge travels around the region, introducing viewers to Southern tastemakers, food, culture and history.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: S08 E02 — Charleston, S.C. The subject of endless magazine listicles and breathless influencer reels; is it possible to sidestep the algorithms and really see and hear and taste Charleston?

programme.title: College Basketball Duke at NC State
programme.desc: Duke at NC State No. 1 Blue Devils travel to face Wolfpack. Darrion Williams leads the Wolfpack in scoring, while Cameron Boozer utilizes superior footwork to score through contact for the Blue Devils. The top spot in the ACC hangs in the balance here.

programme.title: College Basketball North Carolina at Duke
programme.desc: North Carolina at Duke The No. 1 Blue Devils host the No. 17 Tar Heels at Cameron Indoor Stadium in Durham. Duke sits atop the ACC standings with North Carolina in fourth place. North Carolina won the first meeting of the season in a dramatic fashion defeating Duke 71-68.

programme.title: College Basketball ACC Tournament: Clemson vs. Duke
programme.desc: ACC Tournament: Clemson vs. Duke The Duke Blue Devils face the Clemson Tigers in the semifinals of the ACC Men's Basketball Tournament. The winner of this matchup will advance to the ACC Championship game. Cameron Boozer leads No. 1 seed Duke in scoring, rebounds, and assists.

programme.title: College Basketball ACC Tournament: Virginia vs. Duke
programme.desc: ACC Tournament: Virginia vs. Duke T. Rowe Price ACC Tournament concludes as No.1 Duke and No.10 Virginia fight for the title. The Blue Devils won the regular-season meeting, but the Cavaliers have won four straight games. A spot in the NCAA Tournament as a top seed is on the line.

programme.title: College Basketball Kansas at North Carolina

programme.title: College Basketball Kansas at Colorado
programme.desc: Kansas at Colorado Kansas (12-5) visits Colorado at the CU Events Center for a Big 12 game on Jan. 20. The Jayhawks come off an 84-63 upset of No. 2 Iowa State, led by senior Tre White. White's 19 points in the win raised his team-leading scoring average to 15.4 ppg.

programme.title: College Basketball BYU at Kansas

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken traybake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Stove Top Pizza with Caramelized Onions and Peppers Jamie makes super-simple stuffed chicken thighs and a pizza that doesn't need the oven on. He turns the humble pancake into a showstopping stack of spinach, ham and cheesey gorgeousness.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Cajun Chicken Casserole Jamie celebrates the one dish wonder of a casserole with a Cajun chicken tray bake and a vegetable lasagna.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: S01 E05 — No Churn Ice Cream Delight Jamie Oliver makes a giant Yorkshire pudding with stuffing and roast veg, cheesy gnocchi with bacon, spicy kipper kedgeree, and easy ice cream, all for under a buck a plate.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Time Saving Take Out at Home Jamie cooks up some versatile meatball kebabs, delicious crispy pork noodles, a magnificent carrot puff pastry and a humble crumble, all for under a buck per serving.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking for Less
programme.desc: S01 E04 — One Pan Wonders Jamie celebrates frozen ingredients to create a scrumptious fish pie, creamy cauliflower cheese spaghetti and a warming minestrone soup, all for under a buck per plate.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E02 — Guayabera World In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E04 — An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E09 — Yucatán's Most Unique Salts An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the most unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E10 — A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Crispy Chicken Oven Hack Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Pantry Pasta and Rice Pudding Pops Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Freezer Friendly Favorites Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Shake Up Your Salads Jamie's dressing a salad with a crown of cheese! He's also got a speedy twist on Sunday roast chicken and an elegant apple tart all with 5 fabulous ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and alioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France.
